To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of 5% of Azolla pinnate meal in broilers feed significantly improved the overall acceptability, cooking loss, pH value, moisture, protein content and cooking yield of the broiler meat.
the overall acceptablility of cooked meat was higher in broilers offered azolla meal at 3 and 5 percent substitution.
Azolla supplementation up to 5 percent in poultry broiler diet did not significantly affect the carcass, chemical and organoleptic properties of broiler meat.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of Azolla meal in broiler chicken diets and the effect of this substitution on carcass and physico-chemical characteristics of meat.
the use of Azolla as a potential source of protein for broilers.
the use of Azolla meal as unconventional protein source in commercial broiler feed up-to 5 percent level.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Azolla supplementation at 5 percent level is beneficial for the overall performance of broilers.
dried Azolla can be used as an alternative feed ingredient in poultry broiler diet without affecting the quality of meat.
the inclusion of Azolla pinnate in poultry diet at 5 percent level is safe and effective in improving the carcass and physico-chemical properties of broiler chicken meat.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Azolla meal can safely be used up to 5% level in broiler feed without any adverse effect on the quality of meat.
the Azolla meal can safely be used as a feed ingredient in poultry broiler diets up to 5.0 per cent level.
Azolla supplementation in broiler feed can be safely used as an unconventional feed ingredient up to 5 percent level in broiler feed without affecting the organo-leptic quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Azolla can be used as a substitute in poultry feed up to 2.5 to 5.0% level without affecting the meat quality of the broiler chickens.
the use of Azolla in poultry feed is a viable and economical option to reduce the feed costs.
Azolla is a good source of protein, which is a good alternative to soybean meal in poultry diets.
